points.description: Explains an effect of the background information on Paul: Paul recognizes that Mr. Leonard's struggles with reading mirror his own, which creates empathy/a bond and makes Paul want to help Mr. Leonard in return.

Supports the response with a relevant detail from the story, such as Paul's recognition that Mr. Leonard's emotions were 'all too familiar' or his offer to help by saying 'It's time to start your training.'

rubric.notes: Full marks require both a clear statement of how the background information affects Paul and a relevant supporting detail from the story. A response with only the effect or only a detail earns one mark. Equivalent wording and other accurate details from the story are acceptable.
